body:
We should add a check to ensure that MITM protection is in place for the DTLS certificate. This should be added to [53.2](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x53-V53-WebRTC.md#v532-media).

Suggested text is the following:

> [ADDED] Verify that the DTLS certificate is checked against the SDP fingerprint attribute, terminating the media stream if the check fails, to ensure the authenticity of the media stream.
title: Add DTLS certificate / SDP fingerprint attribute verification to WebRTC chapter (53.2)
